reasoning_content: The negative ProxyPass needs a valid absolute URL target. Let me use a dummy absolute URL.

action.command:
sed -i 's|ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver /|ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver http://127.0.0.1:18080/nomatch|' /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 3
echo "=== MapServer via Apache on :8080/xplan-mapserver ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "mapserver GetCapabilities: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1" | head -c 150; echo
